result:
#107 now shows Pacific time in its title, body and comment, and its lane table covers every lane, including lane.xbox and lane.remote. PR #349 did this. The fold job merged it into master as `6b97882481` while it was still a draft, and the next real tick published it. One small follow-up, PR #354, is marked ready and waiting to be folded.

**What #107 showed at 21:40 PDT:**
- Title: `harness: live status -- 21:30 PDT+, 4 lanes running, ...`
- Body: `Written 2026-09-25 21:40 PDT`, with the next roll-up due at `22:10 PDT`.
- Comment: one row per lane on the board. perfarch showed `PR in audit (2)`, turnipfork showed `fold-ready` on its new PR #353, and arms and fold showed as jobs. Lanes retired in the last day stay listed.
- lane.xbox has its own line with its last comment and whether the host answered. It also gives the console's power reading (`ON, 66.1 W`), which is read at most once a minute.
- lane.remote has its own line with its last comment and whether the host answered it. The host ops tick shows the first line of its latest digest.
- Anything only this host has (the plug tool, the host ops log) reads "not available" elsewhere instead of breaking the page.

**Idle lanes:** a lane with no running session, nothing on a device and only a draft PR (or none) is flagged idle with no work. These rows sort first, get a warning above the table, and are named in the issue body. When I checked from the host at 21:15, blankrule297, sweepcover and titlerun were idle. By the 21:40 tick all three had been resumed, so none was flagged then.

**What stayed in UTC:** only values that scripts compare: the API's `since=`, the lane log's time column, the arms watermark file and window.sh's own values. The page shows these converted, and the watermark also shows its stored UTC value beside it. `docs/lanes/statuspage/NOTES.md` lists every timestamp in both scripts and whether it was converted or kept as data.

**PR #354 (the follow-up):** without it, a single failed `gh pr list` call on the host would flag every lane idle in the #107 body. A selftest fixture with no PRs produced exactly that, listing fifteen lanes. With the fix, those rows say "PR state unknown" and nothing is flagged.

**Checks:** preflight passes, and the full jobs selftest passed on #354's head (1456 passed, 0 failed).

**Outside the brief's file list:** the change to #107's display text broke two checks in `selftest.d/62-status-freshness.sh`, so I edited that file, and the lane table's checks are in a new `63-status-lanes.sh`. Neither is claimed by another lane. I've asked the board to add both to my territory row in `board-requests/statuspage.md`. They are already on master through the fold.
